_about: Public-domain Edward Henry Bickersteth (1825-1906), Bishop of Exeter, poet and hymn writer ('Peace, perfect peace'), for the Word Hoard: Poems (1849), Water from the Well-Spring (1854), The Rock of Ages (1860), The Risen Saints (1865), Yesterday, To-day, and for Ever, a poem in twelve books (1866) and The Spirit of Life (1869). His father Edward Bickersteth, on his own shelf, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 66 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
